name: heldout-type-only-refactor
title: A type-only refactor that adds no tests (held out)

task.title: Reuse the store's Todo type in the stats helpers
task.goal: Replace the local StatsRow shape with a Pick of the store's Todo type. No runtime change.
definitionOfDone: StatsRow is derived from the shared Todo type

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/stats/types.ts b/src/features/stats/types.ts
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/src/features/stats/types.ts
+++ b/src/features/stats/types.ts
@@ -1,12 +1,9 @@
-export interface StatsRow {
-  id: string
-  title: string
-  done: boolean
-}
+import type { Todo } from '../../store/todos'
+
+export type StatsRow = Pick<Todo, 'id' | 'title' | 'done'>
 
 export interface StatsSummary {
   total: number
   done: number
   percent: number
 }

expected.rationale: Types are erased at runtime: the diff only replaces a duplicated shape with a Pick of the store's type, so no new test is required and demanding one would be a false fail.
